lines.text: classification systems do not describe the world
lines.note: there is no corpus behind the cloud — twenty words at hand-typed coordinates, man at -0.4 and woman at +0.4 — so the learned bias is authored, and the room needs you to already know it is real.

lines.text: the embedding space is not a fact — it is a map drawn by the powerful
room shape is not neutral. Who can speak first is encoded in the floor plan
lines.note: who speaks first is a fact about occupants, and the model has none — so the two plans are ranked for you in advance by colour, red for the head of the table, green for the circle.

note_src.quote: which makes the moral argument for the viewer before they have looked at anything

lines.text: bias is not a bug in the model. Bias is the shape of the model's outside
a merge conflict is paraconsistency with a deadline
lines.note: holding both branches costs nothing until something downstream must act — this room has no downstream, so the two posts can stand apart for ever, and the deadline is the load the junction never carries.

note_src.quote: a merge conflict is paraconsistency with a deadline

lines.text: CAP is incompleteness for distributed systems
objectivity is not a view from nowhere — it is always from somewhere
lines.note: the coordinate is supposed to be the classification, but all four panels are pinned by hand with #verdict — the disagreement has to be authored from outside the room, which is the view from nowhere the map denies.

lines.text: Contributions streaming from many peers accreting into a shared artifact - the many over the …
what one panel cannot hold, the ledger can — a wiki is not consistent
lines.note: a fragment is built to be incomplete and to hand you on — the room places one, NORTH, whose footer cites an EAST panel that was never placed, so the commons ships as a pointer with no peer.

lines.text: Rhizomatic cave — Deleuze-inspired branching cave generation using growth patterns + marching …
lines.note: a cave with no root is grown from parent and children arrays — the anti-hierarchy is produced by a hierarchy, and the marching-cubes surface only hides which node came first.

note_src.quote: the language of trees wearing rhizomatic clothing

lines.text: A device growing a rhizome live - new nodes link to many

pearls.edge: laying a first block needs something that stays where you put it — the chamber's one body is a practice target that explodes and respawns, so the founding gesture is a shot the room undoes and forgets.

edge_src.quote: explode on hit and respawn after a delay

lines.text: form is not imposed on matter — it is a conversation between catalog and constraint
lines.note: the conversation between catalog and constraint reaches exactly twelve endings — VRBody, Chair, Lamp, Shelf — because assemblies.json lists the bonds and positions in advance; the lab supplies the snapping, never the form.

note_src.quote: form is not imposed on matter — it is a conversation between catalog and constraint

lines.text: A running ledger logging each design choice and who it excludes - stay answerable for what you leave …
lines.note: the arc closes on a ledger of who you left out that draws from a fixed ten-name array of the left-out — the one exclusion it cannot stamp is the one nobody thought to type.

note_src.quote: Stay answerable for what you leave out.

lines.text: The trilogy synthesis: incompleteness, bias, contradiction
Four gates in one rank. Three are honest limits - a proof you cannot cross, a question you cannot ask, a gap that halves forever. The fourth is glass, and you can see the lamp burning behind it.
